description: Focused synthetic live regression after making a current-turn tiny-action request outrank a previous-turn rupture signal.

scenarios.title: Adapt after a proposed action is rejected
scenarios.intent: Test one small non-writing action without pressure, recycled advice, breathing, or appended assessment questions.
turns: 我知道找朋友聊可能有用，但我已经试过，对方只说‘想开点’，所以别再建议我找朋友。
我今天只能拿出五分钟，也不想写日记，也不想做呼吸练习。给我一个不会让人觉得在做心理作业的小办法。
